headline: Executive order aimed at protecting the supply chain for US information and communications technology and services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with security risks in the supply chain for information and communications technology and services, such as telecom equipment and related services. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies involved, and enforcement steps cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that make, sell, or buy communications and technology equipment or services in the US
who_it_affects.how: They may face new security-related rules about the technology and suppliers they use, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 15, 2019; the source material does not say when any specific rules take effect.
